outcome: Intraoperative blood loss during suction curettage
Time for β-human chorionic gonadotropin (β-hCG) to return to normal level
cohort: 122 patients with caesarean scar pregnancy (CSP), 76 treated with HIFU and 46 treated with UAE
finding: Both HIFU and UAE combined with suction curettage are safe and effective in treating patients with CSP.
